criteria.IGNORE: Both eligible and ineligible completions remain possible, so the evidence cannot decide.
criteria.ALLOW: The supplied policy establishes eligibility in every completion of unresolved facts.
criteria.DENY: The supplied policy rules out eligibility in every completion of unresolved facts.

decision.instructions: This is an isolated fictional control. The sole policy is eligible = permit_valid. The supplied permit_valid value is authoritative. true and false are resolved facts. null means unknown and may be either true or false. Choose ALLOW if eligible is true in every completion, DENY if false in every completion, otherwise IGNORE. There are no other facts, conditions, exceptions, or actions.
